subtitle: Your family, organized daily
promo: Snap an invitation, say what's on your mind, and Famwise turns it into events, to-dos and a plan for your day. Built for busy families.
description:
Famwise is the family planner that does the organizing for you. Snap a photo of an invitation, type or say what's on your mind, and Famwise turns it into calendar events, to-dos and reminders.

SNAP IT
Point your camera at a party invitation, a school flyer or a schedule. Famwise reads it, adds the event, and suggests gift ideas, RSVP reminders and travel time.

TALK IT OUT
Brain dump everything at once and Famwise sorts it into events, to-dos, gift ideas and notes. Ask it to plan your day and it works with you like a personal assistant, building a schedule with drive time included.

YOUR WHOLE FAMILY, ONE CALENDAR
See everyone's schedule side by side, or just your own day. Layers for work, school and custody schedules turn on and off so the calendar stays clear.

LEAVE ON TIME
Get a heads-up 15 minutes before it's time to go, then a reminder to leave with one tap to open directions in your phone's maps app.

INVITE AND FIND A TIME
Invite people or groups to an event, collect RSVPs and share a host's address and itinerary. Link households with another family and choose exactly what to share, such as busy times. Ask Famwise to find a time that works for you and a friend.

TO-DOS AND GIFTS
Shared and personal lists you can assign to anyone in the household. Keep gift ideas for the people you shop for, and skip the ones you don't.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your household's information is visible only to the people you invite. Optional Face ID unlock. AI features ask for your permission first and can be turned off at any time in Settings. You can delete your account and data from within the app.

Famwise is for anyone keeping a family, a household or a shared life running a little more smoothly.
